question: Should Nameplate officially maintain Linux installation and upgrades through the steipete Homebrew tap alongside direct release tarballs?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but accepting it expands the supported distribution matrix and creates continuing external-tap and Linux dependency ownership.

options.title: Support Linuxbrew
options.body: Maintain an artifact-backed formula for both Linux architectures and update it automatically with each release.

options.title: Keep tarballs official
options.body: Retain release tarballs as the supported Linux path and leave package-manager formulas community-maintained.

recommendation.title: Support Linuxbrew
recommendation.body: Maintain an artifact-backed formula for both Linux architectures and update it automatically with each release.

likelyOwner.reason: This person controls the existing tap and the repository's release pipeline, so the long-term support commitment belongs with that distribution owner.
